en: The history of Austria and its predecessor states as a field covering the eastern Alps and the Danube valley
Its periods from the early marches and duchies to the empire and the modern republic
zh: 奥地利历史及诸前身政权，地域覆盖东阿尔卑斯与多瑙河流域
时期自早期边区与公国延续至帝国与近代共和国

politics.zh: 奥地利历史及诸前身政权，地域覆盖东阿尔卑斯与多瑙河流域。10世纪起该地区成为神圣罗马帝国的东部边区，1156年升为公国，1278年后由哈布斯堡家族统治，逐步积累阿尔卑斯与多瑙河流域领地；1804年建立奥地利帝国，1867年与匈牙利组成奥匈帝国，1918年帝国解体后建立共和国，1938年被纳粹德国吞并，1955年恢复主权并宣布永久中立。
politics.en: The history of Austria covers Austria and its predecessor states in the eastern Alps and the Danube valley. From the tenth century the area formed the eastern march of the Holy Roman Empire, became a duchy in 1156 and was ruled by the Habsburgs after 1278, gradually accumulating lands in the Alps and along the Danube; an Austrian empire was proclaimed in 1804, the Austro-Hungarian empire was formed with Hungary in 1867 and after its dissolution in 1918 a republic was founded, which was annexed by Nazi Germany in 1938 and regained sovereignty as a permanently neutral state in 1955.

economy.zh: 经济以多瑙河流域的农业、阿尔卑斯山区的畜牧与盐矿、以及维也纳的贸易与手工业为基础，近代工业化以来钢铁、机械与纺织业发展，帝国时期维也纳成为中欧金融与商业中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming along the Danube, herding and salt mining in the Alps and trade and crafts in Vienna, with iron, machinery and textiles developing with modern industrialisation and Vienna becoming a financial and commercial centre of central Europe in the imperial period.

culture.zh: 奥地利文化以德语、天主教传统与宫廷文化为基础，维也纳是音乐与戏剧中心，莫扎特、贝多芬与舒伯特等在此创作，咖啡馆与博物馆文化著名，帝国时期的多民族遗产延续至今。
culture.en: Austrian culture rests on the German language, Catholic tradition and court culture, with Vienna a centre of music and theatre, Mozart, Beethoven and Schubert composing there, its coffee houses and museums well known, and the multinational heritage of the imperial period continuing today.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪东部边区的形成、1278年后哈布斯堡统治的开始、1804年与1867年的帝国阶段、1918年共和国建立，以及1938年并入德国与1955年恢复主权，这些事件共同构成奥地利的历史脉络。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the eastern march in the tenth century, the beginning of Habsburg rule after 1278, the imperial phases of 1804 and 1867, the founding of the republic in 1918 and the annexation of 1938 with the restoration of sovereignty in 1955, events that together make up the historical sequence of Austria.

value.en: It was ruled by the Habsburgs after 1278.

value.zh: 1955年恢复主权并宣布永久中立。
value.en: It regained sovereignty and declared permanent neutrality in 1955.

en: The Taifa of Granada, also known as the Zirid Kingdom of Granada, as a medieval taifa kingdom in southern Iberia
Its rule by the Zirid dynasty and its incorporation into the Almoravid empire
zh: 格拉纳达泰法又称齐里王朝的格拉纳达，是伊比利亚南部的泰法王国
由齐里王朝统治，后被阿尔摩拉维德帝国吞并

politics.zh: 格拉纳达泰法又称齐里王朝的格拉纳达，是伊比利亚南部的泰法王国，1013年在科尔多瓦哈里发国解体后由柏柏尔齐里家族建立，以格拉纳达为中心。它控制内华达山脉北麓的农业与通往沿海的商路，与塞维利亚、马拉加及阿尔梅里亚等泰法互动；1090年前后被阿尔摩拉维德王朝吞并，其地并入北非帝国。
politics.en: The Taifa of Granada, also known as the Zirid Kingdom of Granada, was a medieval taifa kingdom in southern Iberia established in 1013 by the Berber Zirid family as the Caliphate of Cordoba broke up, with Granada as its centre. It controlled the farming of the northern slopes of the Sierra Nevada and the routes to the coast and interacted with the taifas of Seville, Malaga and Almeria; around 1090 it was absorbed by the Almoravids and its lands passed into their North African empire.

economy.zh: 经济以灌溉农业、橄榄与桑树种植、丝织业与山地贸易为基础，格拉纳达的丝绸与纺织品著名，山泉水灌溉系统支撑园艺，谷物与干果是重要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming, olive and mulberry growing, silk weaving and mountain trade, with the silks and textiles of Granada well known, its spring-fed irrigation systems supporting horticulture, and grain and dried fruit among the goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 格拉纳达泰法属安达卢斯文化圈，诗歌与学术在此繁荣，阿尔罕布拉的前身堡垒开始兴建，阿拉伯语与柏柏尔传统交融，犹太与穆斯林社群并存，为后来纳斯里德时期的文化高峰奠定基础。
culture.en: The taifa belonged to the cultural world of Al-Andalus, poetry and scholarship flourishing there, the fortress that preceded the Alhambra being begun, Arab and Berber traditions intermingling, Jewish and Muslim communities coexisting, and a basis being laid for the cultural height of the later Nasrid period.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1013年泰法的建立、11世纪与塞维利亚等泰法的互动、1090年前后被阿尔摩拉维德王朝吞并，以及此后格拉纳达在安达卢斯政治中的延续，这些事件构成安达卢斯诸泰法时期的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the taifa in 1013, its dealings with Seville and other taifas in the eleventh century, its absorption by the Almoravids around 1090 and the later continuation of Granada in Andalusian politics, events that make up the history of the taifa period in Al-Andalus.

value.en: It was established by the Berber Zirid family in 1013.

value.zh: 1090年前后被阿尔摩拉维德王朝吞并。
value.en: It was absorbed by the Almoravids around 1090.

en: Austria, formally the Republic of Austria, as a landlocked country in Central Europe
Its position in the eastern Alps and its borders with eight states
zh: 奥地利正式称奥地利共和国，是中欧内陆国家
位于东阿尔卑斯山区，邻八国

politics.zh: 奥地利共和国是中欧内陆国家，位于东阿尔卑斯山区，邻八国，首都为维也纳。它在1955年依《奥地利国家条约》恢复主权并宣布永久中立，实行联邦制与议会民主制；1995年加入欧洲联盟，1999年加入欧元区，是中欧重要的政治与经济节点。
politics.en: Austria, formally the Republic of Austria, is a landlocked country in Central Europe in the eastern Alps, bordered by eight states, with Vienna as its capital. In 1955 it regained sovereignty under the Austrian State Treaty and declared permanent neutrality, and it is a federal parliamentary democracy; it joined the European Union in 1995 and the euro area in 1999 and is an important political and economic node in central Europe.

economy.zh: 经济以机械制造、汽车零部件、钢铁、化工、旅游与服务业为基础，中小企业与出口导向产业重要，阿尔卑斯旅游业发达，维也纳是国际组织与金融中心之一。
economy.en: The economy rests on machinery, vehicle components, steel, chemicals, tourism and services, with small and medium-sized firms and export-oriented industry important, Alpine tourism well developed, and Vienna one of the centres of international organisations and finance.

culture.zh: 奥地利文化以德语、天主教传统与音乐遗产为基础，维也纳爱乐乐团与国家歌剧院闻名世界，咖啡馆与冬季运动构成生活文化，各地区民俗与方言传统保留。
culture.en: Austrian culture rests on the German language, Catholic tradition and musical heritage, with the Vienna Philharmonic and the State Opera world famous, coffee houses and winter sports forming part of everyday culture, and regional folklore and dialect traditions preserved.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1955年恢复主权与永久中立、1995年加入欧洲联盟、1999年加入欧元区，以及此后的欧洲一体化参与，这些事件决定了现代奥地利的国际地位。
events.en: Key moments are the restoration of sovereignty and permanent neutrality in 1955, accession to the European Union in 1995, entry into the euro area in 1999 and participation in European integration since then, events that have determined the international position of modern Austria.

value.zh: 1955年恢复主权并宣布永久中立。
value.en: It regained sovereignty and declared permanent neutrality in 1955.
It joined the European Union in 1995 and the euro area in 1999.

en: The Kingdom of Lithuania as a sovereign state that existed from 1251 until the death of Mindaugas
Its short existence and its transformation back into a grand duchy
zh: 立陶宛王国是1251年至明道加斯去世期间存在的国家
存在时间短暂，后恢复为大公国

politics.zh: 立陶宛王国是1251年至明道加斯去世期间存在的国家，1251年明道加斯在受洗并与教廷建立关系后获教皇授予王位，1253年加冕，是立陶宛历史上唯一的王国。它由明道加斯统一诸部落建立，与条顿骑士团、加利奇-沃里尼亚及本地贵族互动；1263年明道加斯被刺杀，王国终结，立陶宛恢复为大公国。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Lithuania was a sovereign state that existed from 1251 until the death of Mindaugas; in 1251 Mindaugas was baptised and entered into relations with the papacy, receiving a royal crown and being crowned in 1253, the only kingdom in Lithuanian history. It was founded by Mindaugas as he unified the tribes and interacted with the Teutonic Order, Galicia-Volhynia and the local nobility; in 1263 Mindaugas was assassinated, the kingdom came to an end and Lithuania returned to being a grand duchy.

economy.zh: 经济以波罗的海地区的农业、林业、毛皮与琥珀贸易为基础，河流连接内陆与波罗的海商路，谷物、毛皮与蜂蜡是重要交换物，贸易城镇逐步形成。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, forestry, the fur and amber trades of the Baltic region, with rivers linking the interior with Baltic routes, grain, furs and wax among the goods exchanged, and trading towns gradually taking shape.

culture.zh: 立陶宛王国时期波罗的部落传统与基督教接触，明道加斯的受洗带来拉丁教会的进入，本地多神信仰仍在民间延续，编年史与教廷文书记录了这一时期，语言与口头传统保存了早期记忆。
culture.en: In the period of the kingdom Baltic tribal tradition met Christianity, the baptism of Mindaugas bringing the Latin church in, local pagan beliefs continuing among the people, chronicles and papal documents recording the period, and language and oral tradition preserving early memory.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1251年明道加斯受洗与获授王位、1253年加冕、与条顿骑士团的冲突，以及1263年明道加斯被刺杀与王国终结，这些事件决定了立陶宛早期的政治形态。
events.en: Key moments are the baptism and royal grant of 1251, the coronation of 1253, the conflicts with the Teutonic Order and the assassination of Mindaugas and the end of the kingdom in 1263, events that determined the early political form of Lithuania.

value.zh: 1263年明道加斯被刺杀，王国终结。
value.en: Mindaugas was assassinated in 1263 and the kingdom ended.

en: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, as a landlocked country in south-eastern Europe
Its position in the Balkans and its borders with Serbia, Kosovo, Bulgaria, Greece and Albania
zh: 北马其顿正式称北马其顿共和国，是东南欧内陆国家
位于巴尔干，邻塞尔维亚、科索沃、保加利亚、希腊与阿尔巴尼亚

politics.zh: 北马其顿共和国是东南欧内陆国家，位于巴尔干，邻塞尔维亚、科索沃、保加利亚、希腊与阿尔巴尼亚，首都为斯科普里。它1991年自南斯拉夫和平独立，因国名争议与希腊长期谈判，2018年《普雷斯帕协议》后改称北马其顿，2019年加入北约；2020年启动加入欧盟的谈判进程。
politics.en: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in south-eastern Europe in the Balkans, bordered by Serbia, Kosovo, Bulgaria, Greece and Albania, with Skopje as its capital. It became independent peacefully from Yugoslavia in 1991 and, after a long dispute with Greece over its name, changed it to North Macedonia under the Prespa agreement of 2018 and joined NATO in 2019; negotiations on joining the European Union began in 2020.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、农业、矿业与服务业为基础，纺织、汽车零部件与金属加工是重要部门，葡萄酒与烟草是特色农产品，外资与侨汇对经济作用明显。
economy.en: The economy rests on manufacturing, farming, mining and services, with textiles, vehicle components and metalworking among the important sectors, wine and tobacco distinctive farm products, and foreign investment and remittances clearly important to the economy.

culture.zh: 北马其顿文化以马其顿语、东正教传统与民俗为基础，奥赫里德地区的教堂与湖滨城镇被列为世界遗产，音乐与舞蹈传统丰富，阿尔巴尼亚裔等社群并存，拜占庭与奥斯曼遗产交织。
culture.en: North Macedonian culture rests on the Macedonian language, Orthodox tradition and folklore, the churches and lakeside town of Ohrid being World Heritage, its music and dance traditions rich, Albanian and other communities coexisting, and Byzantine and Ottoman heritage interwoven.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1991年和平独立、1990年代与希腊的国名争议、2001年的内部冲突与《奥赫里德协议》，以及2018年《普雷斯帕协议》与2019年加入北约，这些事件塑造了现代北马其顿。
events.en: Key moments are the peaceful independence of 1991, the name dispute with Greece in the 1990s, the internal conflict of 2001 and the Ohrid agreement and the Prespa agreement of 2018 with NATO accession in 2019, events that have shaped modern North Macedonia.

value.en: It became independent peacefully from Yugoslavia in 1991.

value.zh: 2018年《普雷斯帕协议》后改称北马其顿。
value.en: It was renamed North Macedonia under the Prespa agreement of 2018.

en: The Kingdom of Wurttemberg as a German state in south-western Germany
Its creation in 1806 and its incorporation into the German Empire in 1871
zh: 符腾堡王国是德国西南部的邦国

politics.zh: 符腾堡王国是德国西南部的邦国，1806年在拿破仑支持下由公国升为王国，以斯图加特为都，由符腾堡家族统治。它在维也纳会议后成为德意志邦联成员，1819年颁布宪法建立两院制议会；1866年支持奥地利，1871年加入德意志帝国，1918年革命后成为自由邦，1952年并入巴登-符腾堡。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Wurttemberg was a German state in south-western Germany, raised from a duchy to a kingdom with Napoleonic support in 1806, with Stuttgart as its capital and ruled by the House of Wurttemberg. It became a member of the German Confederation after the Congress of Vienna and adopted a constitution with a two-chamber parliament in 1819; it sided with Austria in 1866, joined the German Empire in 1871, became a free state after the revolution of 1918 and was incorporated into Baden-Wurttemberg in 1952.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、葡萄酒、纺织与机械制造为基础，斯图加特与海尔布隆是工业与商业中心，19世纪机械、汽车与精密工业发展，手工业传统与职业教育体系相互支撑。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, wine, textiles and machinery, with Stuttgart and Heilbronn as centres of industry and commerce, machinery, vehicles and precision industry developing in the nineteenth century, and craft traditions and the vocational training system supporting each other.

culture.zh: 符腾堡王国留下宫殿、教堂与大学遗产，图宾根大学是重要学术中心，诗人席勒与哲学家黑格尔在此求学，葡萄酒文化与新教传统影响地方生活，博物馆与音乐传统延续。
culture.en: The kingdom left palaces, churches and a university as heritage, the University of Tubingen being an important centre of scholarship, the poet Schiller and the philosopher Hegel studying there, wine culture and Protestant tradition shaping local life, and museums and musical traditions continuing.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1806年升为王国、1819年颁布宪法、1866年支持奥地利、1871年加入德意志帝国，以及1918年后成为自由邦并最终并入巴登-符腾堡，这些事件决定了该邦的现代归属。
events.en: Key moments are its elevation to a kingdom in 1806, the constitution of 1819, its support for Austria in 1866, entry into the German Empire in 1871 and its becoming a free state after 1918 and eventual incorporation into Baden-Wurttemberg, events that determined its modern status.

value.en: It was raised to a kingdom in 1806.
It was incorporated into Baden-Wurttemberg in 1952.

en: The Taifa of Arcos as a Berber medieval taifa kingdom in southern Iberia
Its brief existence in the eleventh century and its absorption by Seville
zh: 阿尔科斯泰法是伊比利亚南部的柏柏尔泰法王国
11世纪短暂存在，后被塞维利亚吞并

politics.zh: 阿尔科斯泰法是伊比利亚南部的柏柏尔泰法王国，1011年前后在科尔多瓦哈里发国解体后建立，位于今加的斯省一带，以阿尔科斯-德拉弗龙特拉为中心。它由柏柏尔家族统治，控制瓜达莱特河流域的农业与通往塞维利亚及直布罗陀方向的商路；1069年被塞维利亚泰法吞并，其地随后归阿尔摩拉维德王朝。
politics.en: The Taifa of Arcos was a Berber medieval taifa kingdom in southern Iberia established around 1011 as the Caliphate of Cordoba broke up, in what is now Cadiz province and centred on Arcos de la Frontera. Ruled by a Berber family, it controlled the farming of the Guadalete valley and the routes towards Seville and the direction of Gibraltar; in 1069 it was absorbed by the taifa of Seville and its lands later passed to the Almoravids.

economy.zh: 经济以瓜达莱特河流域的灌溉农业、橄榄与谷物种植、畜牧与市镇贸易为基础，河畔城镇是区域市场，橄榄油、谷物与牲畜是重要交换物，山地要塞控制通道。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming in the Guadalete valley, olive and grain growing, herding and urban trade, with the riverside towns serving as regional markets, olive oil, grain and livestock among the goods exchanged, and hill fortresses controlling the passes.

culture.zh: 阿尔科斯泰法属安达卢斯文化圈，山城与城堡遗址留下遗存，阿拉伯语诗歌与学术在此流传，柏柏尔统治层与本地社群共处，灌溉技术与乡土建筑延续至后世。
culture.en: The taifa belonged to the cultural world of Al-Andalus, its hill town and castle surviving as remains, Arabic poetry and scholarship circulating there, its Berber ruling group living alongside local communities, and its irrigation techniques and vernacular building continuing in later periods.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1011年前后泰法的建立、与塞维利亚的长期互动、1069年被塞维利亚吞并，以及此后归入阿尔摩拉维德王朝，这些事件构成安达卢斯诸泰法时期的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the taifa around 1011, its long dealings with Seville, its absorption by Seville in 1069 and its later passage to the Almoravids, events that make up the history of the taifa period in Al-Andalus.

value.en: It was absorbed by Seville in 1069.

en: The French First Republic as the republican regime in France from 1792 to 1804
Its proclamation after the fall of the monarchy and its replacement by the First Empire
zh: 法兰西第一共和国是1792至1804年法国的共和政体
在君主制被推翻后宣告成立，后被第一帝国取代

politics.zh: 法兰西第一共和国是1792至1804年法国的共和政体，1792年国民公会宣布废除君主制后成立，经历国民公会、督政府与执政府三个阶段。它面临对外战争与内部动乱，推行普选、世俗化与法典化改革，1793至1794年经历恐怖统治；1799年拿破仑发动雾月政变掌权，1804年称帝，共和国被帝国取代。
politics.en: The French First Republic was the republican regime in France from 1792 to 1804, proclaimed by the National Convention after the abolition of the monarchy and passing through the Convention, the Directory and the Consulate. Facing foreign war and internal disorder, it carried out universal suffrage, secularisation and legal codification and went through the Terror of 1793 and 1794; in 1799 Napoleon seized power in the coup of Brumaire and in 1804 he became emperor, the republic being replaced by the empire.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、手工业与海外贸易为基础，革命时期的纸币贬值、战争封锁与国有化政策冲击经济，贸易港口受损，1790年代后期财政与货币逐步重建。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, crafts and overseas trade, with depreciating paper money, wartime blockade and nationalisation policies disrupting it during the revolutionary period, the trading ports suffering damage, and public finances and the currency being gradually rebuilt in the later 1790s.

culture.zh: 第一共和国时期推行世俗教育与新历法，博物馆与科学院改革，报刊与政治俱乐部活跃，革命节庆与公民宗教塑造公共文化，艺术与音乐服务于新的国家理念。
culture.en: In the period of the First Republic secular education and a new calendar were introduced, museums and academies reformed, the press and political clubs active, and revolutionary festivals and civic religion shaping public culture, while art and music served the new idea of the nation.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1792年共和国宣告成立、1793年路易十六被处死与恐怖统治、1795年督政府建立、1799年雾月政变，以及1804年拿破仑称帝，这些事件构成法国大革命后期的政治史。
events.en: Key moments are the proclamation of the republic in 1792, the execution of Louis XVI and the Terror of 1793, the establishment of the Directory in 1795, the coup of Brumaire in 1799 and the proclamation of the empire in 1804, events that make up the political history of the later French Revolution.

value.en: It was replaced by the First Empire in 1804.
